userStories.title: Implement historian data buffering and batch write
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement buffering and batch writing to InfluxDB.

Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented data buffering and batch write in services/engine-historian/main.go. Added DataPoint struct to store buffered data with Measurement, Tags (organization, site, area, gateway, alias), Fields (value, quality), and Timestamp. Added MQTTPayload struct to parse JSON from MQTT. Created thread-safe buffer with mutex-protected []*DataPoint slice. Added buffer constants: bufferFlushSize=1000, bufferFlushInterval=1s. Implemented addToBuffer() which adds points and triggers flush at 1000 points. Implemented periodicFlush() goroutine that flushes every 1 second via ticker. Implemented flushBufferUnsafe() that writes all buffered points to InfluxDB using WriteAPI and Flush(). Graceful shutdown flushes remaining buffer. Timestamp conversion from milliseconds to nanoseconds for InfluxDB. JSON payload parsing extracts v, ts, q fields.

userStories.title: Implement historian deadband filtering
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement deadband filtering to reduce storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Historian checks tag historize_deadband from PostgreSQL
For each new value, compare with previous value stored in Redis
If |new_value - previous_value| < deadband, skip write to buffer
First value for a tag is always written (no previous to compare)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented deadband filtering in services/engine-historian/main.go. Added PostgreSQL connection for loading tag historize and historize_deadband configuration. Created TagInfo struct with ID, Historize, and HistorizeDeadband fields. Added getTagInfo() function that queries PostgreSQL via JOIN across org/site/area/gateway/tags tables, with Redis caching (1 hour TTL) using key format 'tag_info:{org}:{site}:{area}:{gateway}:{alias}'. Added shouldStoreValue() function that retrieves previous value from Redis (key: 'prev_value:{tag_id}') and compares with new value. Added exceedsDeadband() function supporting float64, int, and bool value types with proper numeric comparison using math.Abs(). Added storePreviousValue() function to update Redis after storing value. Boolean values always stored on change (no deadband). Zero or negative deadband disables filtering. Added DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_NAME environment variables. Added engine-historian service to docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL connection and proper dependencies.
